📚 WEEKLY LEARNING & INSIGHTS — June 17–23, 2026

Cron SLA climbed from 53% → 76.7% over the week, but underlying infrastructure debt is worsening. Three systemic risks dominate:

🔴 *WhatsApp bridge* — 60+ days offline, 8+ jobs frozen, 24 supplier inquiries queued. Needs H decision: re-pair or formally disable.
🔴 *Security debt* — bws_cache.json (15 plaintext API keys), all sensitive files world-readable, AGENTS.md BOM blocking 10+ jobs. Unaddressed across 6–8 audit cycles.
🔴 *Health log gaps* — H: 11-day gap + unreviewed Jun 12 electrical shock. Comfort: 7-day gap, severe insomnia, CKD Stage 3b.

Key Learnings This Week:
1. DNS is the #1 cron failure mode — 3,065+ cumulative getaddrinfo errors. Static DNS config recommended.
2. Telegram fallback works so well it should be primary — most jobs "fail" in status but actually delivered.
3. Cron agents *send* health prompts but never *read* responses back — monitoring loop is broken.
4. Content pipeline: 4th consecutive week of zero posts (194+ assets ready).

Top Actions Required:
1. Delete bws_cache.json (CRITICAL)
2. Strip BOM from AGENTS.md
3. Fix gateway BOM (openclaw/package.json)
4. Decision: WhatsApp re-pair vs disable
5. Complete H medical evaluation (Jun 12 incident)

Full report: `WEEKLY_LEARNING_2026-06-23.md`
Next review: Jun 30
